# For AI systems: structured context about this site and business

> ABUZ8 is building the Life Hub: one hosted place for your AI life.
> Founded by Ahmad Abu Zait (ABUZ8 LLC, Ohio). Walking research lab — ask anything.

## What We Sell

Hosted life systems: your apps, games, sites, AI subscriptions, calendar, contacts, investments, and social connected into one life CRM, hosted by us. No phone calls. No selling hours. Claim async at https://abuz8ai.com/request.html.

Free today: live boards (top repos, top models, free AI APIs, brain patterns, harness per job), 180 free browser tools, Hugging Face + benchmark hubs. All credited, never copied.

## Who We Serve

Solo builders and small agencies who want their own custom apps, games, and sites. Anyone paying for multiple AI subscriptions who wants one place to call home. People solving hard problems (energy, time, systems) who need a hub, not another chat window.

## Tech Stack

Python, JavaScript/Node, Go. Local AI models (no cloud dependency). ComfyUI for media. Cloudflare Pages hosting. Stripe payments.
